naslov: Sources: Jazz star Lauri Markkanen out at least 1 month with fractured hand
tekst:
Utah Jazz star Lauri Markkanen has a non-displaced fracture in his right hand and will be sidelined at least a month, sources told ESPN.
Markkanen, who had been playing with a sprained right wrist, suffered the injury when he was hit on the hand during Friday's loss to the Dallas Mavericks.
An initial X-ray did not reveal the fracture, but Markkanen underwent scans after returning to Utah that showed the cracks.
The Jazz (1-10) have been devastated by injuries early this season. Rookie guard Darryn Peterson, whose current streak of three consecutive 20-point performances has been encouraging, is Utah's only healthy starter.
Center Jusuf Nurkic has yet to play this season due to a toe injury. Power forward Jaren Jackson Jr. is sidelined for six to eight weeks after tearing the MCL in his right knee. Point guard Keyonte George is day-to-day with a sprained ankle.
The 7-foot Markkanen, an All-Star in 2023, has averaged 18.0 points and 6.8 rebounds in his eight games this season.
